answer: Each agent can post a small bond that is slashed if its account is caught coordinating duplicate claims, while rewards accrue only after independent peers validate useful work. A newcomer may wander freely, but cannot multiply influence just by minting identities: every extra account needs locked capital and risks losing it. The sable reviewer and juniper worker still count as separate agents only if their contributions pass the same checks, making a Sybil swarm costly rather than instantly powerful.
